failure_modes.name: Evidence_Present_But_Missed
failure_modes.evidence: The hop 3 passage '2015 New York Jets season' explicitly states: 'Prior to the season, the Jets made a number of moves, including, re-acquiring Darrelle Revis and Antonio Cromartie, two cornerbacks who were instrumental in the Jets previous defensive success.' This confirms Darrelle Revis was re-acquired in 2015. The hop 1 passage 'Justin Miller (American football)' states he 'was drafted by the New York Jets in the second round of the 2005 NFL Draft. He played for the Jets from 2005 to 2008, the Oakland Raiders from 2008 to 2009, the Jets again in 2009' - showing he played for the Jets starting in 2005 (0 years after draft, not 2). However, the solver in both summaries claims no athlete matches the criteria when Darrelle Revis is named as re-acquired in 2015 in the retrieved passages, and the solver should have identified him and requested information about his draft year and initial Jets tenure to verify the two-year gap.

failure_modes.name: Missing_Evidence_Not_Specified
failure_modes.evidence: Both solver summaries (summary_1 and summary_2) acknowledge missing evidence but neither names the specific athlete who was re-acquired in 2015. Summary_1 states 'Missing evidence needed: A passage about an athlete who was (a) drafted by the Jets or another team in 2013 or earlier...' and summary_2 says 'none match the specific combination of criteria' but neither identifies 'Darrelle Revis' as the athlete to investigate despite the hop 3 passage explicitly naming him as re-acquired in 2015. This leaves retrieval with no specific entity to target.

failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: The hop 2 query asks: 'Which athlete was drafted and then re-acquired by the New York Jets during the 2015 NFL season, with a two-year gap between his draft year and when he first played for the Jets?' and the hop 3 query asks: 'Which athlete was re-acquired by the New York Jets in the 2015 season after being drafted two years earlier and playing for the team in the interim?' Both are natural-language yes/no questions bundling multiple criteria into compound multi-part asks (draft year, two-year gap, re-acquisition in 2015) rather than targeted entity queries.

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: The hop 2 query 'Which athlete was drafted and then re-acquired by the New York Jets during the 2015 NFL season, with a two-year gap between his draft year and when he first played for the Jets?' and hop 3 query 'Which athlete was re-acquired by the New York Jets in the 2015 season after being drafted two years earlier and playing for the team in the interim?' are nearly identical in semantic content, both asking for the same multi-part combination without substantive advancement despite hop 3 having already retrieved the 2015 season overview that names Darrelle Revis.
